known_issues: The eight inspection dimensions retain their original narrow qualifications; normalized text equality and forward/reverse linkage are not scientific interpretation, role semantics, visible glyph verification, reading order or full PDF/UA accessibility.

The source-aware job and structure adapter retain distinct unchanged profiles and guards. Matching PDF, source, page-plan, job and parsed-MCID counts is unsigned metadata agreement, not authenticated execution.

The 300-second post-admission limit checks acceptance between synchronous outer stages and before return. It does not preempt an in-flight child or enforce aggregate CPU, memory, scratch, descriptor or descendant budgets.
The 26-call bound counts existing adapters, not every native descendant. Each underlying guarded process keeps its original finite limits.
Existing bounded native-JSON source capture and subsequent comparisons detect persistent changes. They do not provide an atomic snapshot against concurrent mutate-and-restore behavior.
No retry, caller-provided receipt, custom executor, durable checkpoint or resume input is accepted.

The optional profile admits at most 64 physical pages and 8 MiB, conditional on all unchanged parser/graph/depth budgets. A 64-heading automatic bookmark chain exceeding depth 64 is still rejected; admitted synthetic 64-page fixtures omit those bookmarks during generation only.
The default 32-page/8-MiB rendering and delivery route remains unchanged. This composition does not activate long-report delivery or report release.
